slides.title_en: The wedding reaches its third line before the ghost story shows itself.
slides.copy_zh: 拜堂與紅妝都照規矩進行；「新娘回魂夜」一出現，熟悉的喜事立刻開始不對勁。
slides.copy_en: The bows and red bridal makeup follow the rules; “The bride returns tonight” makes the familiar celebration turn wrong at once.

slides.title_zh: 武打要讓人看懂出手，也看懂結果。
slides.title_en: A fight should make both the strike and its result readable.
slides.copy_zh: 近身動作留住受擊點，群戰守住人物走位，出劍帶起的水花把力道畫清楚。
slides.copy_en: Close action keeps the impact point visible, ensemble combat preserves blocking, and water kicked up by the blade draws the force clearly.

slides.title_zh: 特效進場前，演員得先相信它在那裡。
slides.title_en: Before VFX enters, the actors need to believe it is there.
slides.copy_zh: 手勢帶出能量、全家迎上巨龍、白袍走到黑袍；效果各自不同，表演始終給得出它的位置。
slides.copy_en: A gesture releases energy, a family faces a dragon, and white robes turn black; each effect is different, but every one has a performance to hold onto.

slides.title_en: “So close” lands on the players’ faces.
slides.copy_zh: 那一下懊惱被群像接住，Google Play Points 才能補上片名裡少掉的那一「點」。
slides.copy_en: The ensemble carries that flash of frustration, giving Google Play Points a reason to supply the missing “point” in the title.

slides.title_zh: 磁浮看不見，就讓藍光貼著臉頰走。
slides.title_en: Magnetic suspension is invisible, so the blue light follows the cheek.
slides.copy_zh: 刀頭碰到暖色肌膚時，冷藍光才出現；產品規格因此有了能被看見的動作。
slides.copy_en: It appears as the razor meets warm skin, giving the product feature a movement the audience can see.

director.tagline_zh: 遊戲廣告 · 商業影像 · 真人實拍 · CG · AI 影像
director.tagline_en: Game Advertising · Commercial Film · Live Action · CG · AI Film
director.point_of_view_zh: 畫面得先讓人想看下去，人物也要站得住；產品走進來時，最好像角色本來就會做的選擇。
director.point_of_view_en: The image has to earn another look, and the character has to hold. When the product enters, it should feel like a choice that character would naturally make.
director.bio_zh: 鄭又勛，台灣導演，主要拍遊戲廣告與商業影像。真人、CG 或 AI 都能用，前提是角色得先成立，產品才不會像後來塞進去的。
director.bio_en: York Cheng is a Taiwan-based director working mainly in game advertising and commercial films. Live action, CG and AI can all work; the character has to hold first, or the product will always feel added afterward.

contact.location_zh: 台灣 · 可洽跨市場合作

works.copy_zh: 「夠嗎？」問的根本不是同一件事：刀還舉著時是在挑釁，1250ml 大瓶茶一上桌，就成了夠不夠大家喝。
works.copy_en: “Is that enough?” changes meaning inside the scene: with the blades still raised, it is a challenge; once the 1,250ml bottles reach the table, it becomes a question of whether there is enough tea to share.

works.copy_zh: 三個問句，把權力、愛情與兄弟留在林志穎的三杯酒裡。
works.copy_en: Three questions leave power, love and brotherhood in Jimmy Lin’s three cups.

works.copy_zh: 白袍的倖存者一路被綠色魔氣吞沒，黑袍和白骨王座只是這段變化的落點。成魔好不好看，關鍵都在中間。
works.copy_en: Green energy slowly overtakes the survivor in white. The black robes and bone throne are only the destination; the transformation lives in the passage between them.

works.copy_zh: 不拍抓鬼，讓拜堂字卡一張張數到新娘回魂。
works.copy_en: Do not chase the ghost; let each wedding card count down to the bride’s return.

works.copy_zh: 蒙眼不是裝飾。變身前後兩位劍客都遮住雙眼，最後一句「我看得見」，才把看不見翻成武功。
works.copy_en: The blindfold is not decoration. Both swordsmen enter the transformation unable to see; “I can see” lands only after blindness has become the skill.

works.title_en: ROU CI FANG — The Way of Meat
works.copy_zh: 現切原塊肉，也有肉道黑帶的三型招式。
works.copy_en: Cutting whole meat to order becomes a three-form, black-belt discipline.

works.title_zh: 舒適牌 HydroPRO 磁浮刮鬍刀
works.copy_zh: 純黑舞台只留一圈冷藍，讓磁浮在刀頭貼上臉頰時被看見。
works.copy_en: Against pure black, one cold-blue ring makes magnetic suspension visible as the razor meets the cheek.

works.title_zh: Google Play 台灣《就差一點》
works.copy_zh: 玩家那口不甘心，和 Google Play Points 少掉的一「點」其實是同一個笑點。那口氣演對了，Points 出來就不用另外解釋。
works.copy_en: The player’s frustration and the missing “point” in Google Play Points are the same joke. Get that frustration right, and Points needs no separate explanation when it appears.

works.copy_zh: 「人生最大的對手，正是自己。」棋子落下時看見的是戰功，兜帽揭開，這句話才對上同一張臉。
works.copy_en: “Your greatest opponent is yourself.” The moves seem to reveal a campaign; when the hood comes off, the line lands on the same face.

works.title_en: Soul Land: World of Soul Hunters
works.copy_zh: 《終極一班》班底不回頭，在真實校園裡換一種武魂再成軍。
works.copy_en: The KO One cast forms up again, this time with martial souls inside a real campus.

works.copy_zh: 任家萱與任容萱本來就是姊妹，所以古今兩條線不用解釋太多。圓鏡和窗格把時空隔開，兩人之間的熟悉感一直都在。
works.copy_en: Real-life sisters play one in the past and one in the present, so the bond needs little explanation. Mirrors and window frames keep the eras apart while their familiarity remains.

works.copy_zh: 女戰士的臉故意藏著，畫面只讓紅燭、黑甲和血月說話。職業卡一排開，「選擇你的命運吧」就從台詞變成玩家要做的事。
works.copy_en: The warrior’s face stays hidden, leaving red candles, black armour and a blood moon to speak for the ritual. Once the class cards fill the frame, “Choose your fate” stops being a line and becomes the player’s decision.

works.copy_zh: 從黑色晚禮服到赤壁紅袍，遠古召喚把林心如的前世叫醒。
works.copy_en: From a black evening gown to red robes at Red Cliffs, an ancient call wakes Ruby Lin’s past life.

works.copy_zh: 凌煙以扇作兵，桃花出劍帶起水花。兩支十五秒，各替一位紅顏留下一小段傳記。
works.copy_en: Ling Yan turns a fan into a weapon; Taohua’s sword throws water into the air. Two fifteen-second films leave each woman a short chapter of her own.

works.copy_zh: 《開天》拆開來看才好拍：冰龍和雷電是「天」，那一劍才是「開」。
works.copy_en: Kaitian became clearer once the title was split in two: the ice dragon and lightning are the “heaven”; the sword strike is the “opening.”

works.copy_zh: 一句「這些魔靈召喚都用送的」，把正經台語對峙推到百抽爆開。演員不先笑，笑點才留給觀眾。
works.copy_en: A dead-serious Taiwanese standoff lands on “all these summons are free,” then bursts into a hundred-pull payoff. The cast never winks, so the laugh stays with the audience.

works.copy_zh: 巨龍從落地窗外找上門；少年舉起手機，下一秒全家已經變成遊戲隊伍。
works.copy_en: A dragon arrives outside the picture window; the boy raises his phone, and the whole family becomes the game party in the next beat.

works.copy_zh: 小紅帽帶回狼頭，白雪改問最強大；童話走到一半，受害者開始掌局。
works.copy_en: Red Riding Hood brings back the wolf’s head; Snow White asks for power. Halfway through, the victims take control.

works.copy_zh: 鰲拜的「我要」一路加成「我全都要」，片尾手機替整張集卡清單結帳。
works.copy_en: Oboi’s “I want it” grows into “I want it all,” and the final phone checks out the whole card-collection list.

works.copy_zh: 同一枚玉珮從今生喚回前世，再把千年等待收進一次回頭。
works.copy_en: One jade pendant calls back the past, then gathers a thousand-year wait into one final look.

works.copy_zh: 花、氣球和那些容易被忽略的美，比規格更適合站在前面。雙螢幕也不是功能表，而是把這些細節做出來的工具。
works.copy_en: Flowers, balloons and overlooked details deserve the frame before the specifications do. The dual screens are not a feature list; they are the tool that makes those details tangible.

works.copy_zh: 一盒巧克力被放大成整座城市都要抬頭看的聖誕吊飾。貼地仰拍和藍金色，是為了把櫃上的商品拉成一座地標。
works.copy_en: A box of chocolate becomes a Christmas ornament large enough for the whole city to look up at. Low angles and a blue-gold palette turn a counter display into a landmark.

works.title_zh: 舒芙晶透煥亮 CC 刀
works.copy_zh: 四種保養成分沒有被拍成成分表，而是變成繞著刀頭走的透明氣泡。隔離網一出現，安心才成了看得見的東西。
works.copy_en: Four skincare ingredients become clear bubbles moving around the razor head instead of a list of claims. When the protective mesh appears, reassurance becomes something visible.

works.copy_zh: 紅、藍兩隊的光刃、火球和人影都成雙出現，畫面一直把他們分在兩邊。寬鏡一拉開，才發現這些對稱其實都在同一局裡。
works.copy_en: Blades, fireballs and silhouettes appear in red-blue pairs, keeping the two sides apart. Pulling wide reveals that every pair has belonged to the same match.

works.copy_zh: 從獎盃倒著看回去，比一路拍到奪冠更有意思。火光、逆光和隊徽像剛走過的路，選手並肩站好時，那場硬仗才算完整。
works.copy_en: Starting from the trophy and looking backward is more interesting than building toward it. Fire, backlight and team crests feel like the road just travelled; the line-up closes the hard-fought journey.

works.copy_zh: 最好笑的是手機亮出「一億戰力」那一下。街頭本來像幫派在驗資格，一個數字就把整條地位翻過來。
works.copy_en: The sharpest beat is the phone revealing a combat power of one hundred million. The street plays like a gang initiation until a single number reverses the pecking order.

works.copy_zh: 一顆撞色籃球，把停車場、潑漆和城市球場連成同一條弧線。田壘與高國豪不站在世界外面代言，而是帶著球直接走進去。
works.copy_en: One two-tone basketball connects a parking lot, splashes of paint and the city court in a single arc. Rather than endorsers standing outside that world, the two athletes carry the ball straight into it.

works.copy_zh: 啦啦隊原本明亮的青春感不能丟；一道紅光夠了，刀、弓、扇就接手把她們換成武者。日常沒有消失，江湖才進得來。
works.copy_en: The cheer squad’s bright, youthful energy has to stay. One red flash is enough for sword, bow and fan to turn them into warriors. Everyday life never disappears, so the martial world still feels like theirs.

works.copy_zh: 辦公室越正經，桌面、網襪和俯拍就越可疑。視角慢慢偏掉，等權力關係翻面，角色解鎖才剛好成為笑點。
works.copy_en: The straighter the office plays, the more suspicious the desk, fishnets and overhead view become. The camera keeps slipping off-centre until the power dynamic flips and the character unlock lands as the joke.

works.copy_zh: 海灘上並排的三種人生，本來只是選項；一放大成天際線廣告，連鈔票都能掉回街上。荒唐要一路接到真實街道，玩家才有理由相信這場夢。
works.copy_en: Three lives lying side by side on a beach begin as choices; once they expand into skyline billboards, even the money can fall into the street. The absurdity has to reach the real city before the fantasy feels believable.

works.title_zh: 文明與征服／全球大戰篇
works.copy_zh: 大殿拍得越一本正經，吳宗憲那句「有誰不服？」就越好笑。這支片的喜劇沒有多做什麼，只把那一拍留準。
works.copy_en: The more seriously the great hall is played, the funnier Jacky Wu’s “Anyone disagree?” becomes. The comedy comes from doing less and holding that beat precisely.
